study.question: Does field-aligned reading of separate behavior summaries improve validation ranking beyond target-independent history selection and scalar amplitude control?
study.hypothesis: Observed: baseline-static AUC 0.6050036145, baseline-pooled 0.6102261137, baseline-din 0.6133619861, all successful single-seed trajectories; no failed or abandoned local branches are supplied. Code inspection shows baseline-din sums category, brand, action and age before one attention/readout, which removes explicit field identity. DIN exceeds pooled by 0.0031358724 overall, but only 0.0002617450 on category-match-absent versus 0.0026743907 on match-present; these exploratory between-model slice differences are not a causal bottleneck test. Proposed explanation: compact separate field/action evidence may support useful target-conditioned semantic direction changes beyond scalar scaling. Neither the bottleneck nor superiority of this implementation is established.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit target-conditioned relation features and weighted pooling. The original DIN explicitly abandons softmax to preserve intensity; the supplied baseline uses normalized attention. Proposed model first forms eight field/action means, then reads them with norm-matched channel fusion. This is a local adaptation, not an exact DIN reproduction or a verified novel method.

Replace event-level attention over summed history embeddings by field-preserving action means, per-field action selection, and directional versus scalar replacement controls. Add 16 MLP input dimensions and a shared gate, so the baseline is not capacity matched.

README confirms histories have category/brand/type without item identity. No item matching, DMR auxiliary objective, or full DMR reproduction is claimed; publisher paper remains unavailable through this source.

Candidate-conditioned gates are existing work. Here use a small gate on field/action means with a scalar replacement and final per-field norm matching, rather than a SwiGLU sequence encoder, two evolving buses, or FM Highway. No transfer of reported source gains or priority is asserted.

Consider query-construction confounds, but do not adopt cross-attention-generated probes, repeated refinement, multiple embedding views or the source training recipe. Query here is directly an ad field or a history-only context mean; all four local controls share tokenization. Novelty remains unverified beyond these inspected references.

inherited_components: All host-owned information, splits, scorer and training sample coverage remain frozen.
Reference static embedding tables, shared category/brand history tables, embedding_dim=16, action embedding and 33 logarithmic age buckets.
DIN-style [query, evidence, difference, product] relation features with shared 64-hidden PReLU scalar attention.
Reference output MLP hidden [128,64], host BCE/optimizer defaults and lr 0.001; no auxiliary labels or custom optimizer.
study.proposed_difference: Pool supplied causal events by action into separate category and brand means (2x4 tokens), add mean age embedding and action embedding, and mask absent groups. A query per field selects among present actions. The target factor replaces history-derived mean queries by current category/brand embeddings for both selector and gate. The directional factor uses a 32-hidden shared channel gate in [0.5,1.5] instead of its channel mean; normalize each final directional field summary to the corresponding scalar field-summary norm before concatenating two summaries into the static MLP. All four variants compute both paths with identical parameter shapes. This tests the combined target pathway and directional fusion, not which of target selection or target gating individually matters.
predictions: target_directional exceeds baseline-din on full validation AUC; otherwise it is not a better performance candidate.
target_directional exceeds target_scalar and context_directional across paired repetitions if both claimed ingredients help. An isolated single-seed gain is preliminary.

The directional contrast is larger with target queries than context queries if semantic direction changes are specifically useful for current-ad reading; test the predeclared 2x2 difference-in-differences.

At a fixed checkpoint, scalar and directional per-field summary norms match within 1e-4 absolute diagnostic error; empty histories produce exactly zero summaries. Nonzero gate channel variation and altered direction establish operation only, not causal usefulness.

Exploratory: use existing host slice bins/counts for history length, behavior composition, hour, training frequency and category matches. Do not create post-hoc confirmatory bins. The first-512 diagnostic subset cannot establish full-population slice performance.

Only eight token relations per example may reduce attention computation relative to 128 event relations; host wall/GPU time, memory and end-to-end inference measurements must establish any actual efficiency gain.
falsifiers: No repeatable full-validation gain over baseline-din falsifies this implementation as an improvement, without refuting all field-aware readout mechanisms.
A scalar control matching or beating target_directional defeats a claim of benefit beyond amplitude in this design.
context_directional matching or beating target_directional defeats a claim that this gain needs target-conditioned reading.
Nonpositive or unstable factorial interaction prevents a target-specific directional-synergy claim, even if a main effect improves.

Nonfinite logits, nonzero empty-history summaries, inconsistent parameter shapes across controls, or diagnostic norm error above 1e-4 invalidate the intended control and require source correction before interpretation.
Latency or allocated compute outside the cap rejects feasibility; efficiency cannot be inferred from fewer token relations.
alternative_explanations: Equal parameter counts do not imply equal effective capacity or identical optimization.
Separating semantic fields and behavior pooling versus baseline-din changes compression and MLP input width; baseline gain alone cannot attribute target conditioning.
History-conditioned and target-conditioned queries have different distributions.
Each independently trained variant can learn different norms and attention; norm equality is an algebraic within-checkpoint replacement property, not equality between learned checkpoints.
Grouping by action may help because of rare-behavior reweighting, while averaging within action may destroy useful multimodal or recency-specific evidence.
Gains over baseline may come from wider readouts or added gate capacity, not target specificity.
Validation selection and seed noise can explain one favorable result; no user-cluster confidence interval is available unless supplied by the authorized evaluator.
Static publisher snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; this frozen benchmark does not establish production point-in-time validity.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: runtime estimated_unit_seconds=704.37297296; baseline-din wall=610.81949861 and train=522.06530099; hard per-trial cap=1760.93243240 seconds. Starting remaining_seconds=86399.64790392 includes all subsequent preparation.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Four initial trials: nominal 2817.5 seconds, conservative cap reserve 7043.8 seconds. Reserve another 14087.5 seconds (8 capped units) for discriminating follow-ups including failures, retries and diagnostics; do not assume unknown calls are free. Analytical estimate at d=16 is 17,134,932 total parameters (4,657 more than baseline-din); exact counts require host measurement. All four variant parameter shapes and dense operations are equal apart from selecting the final computed branch.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 26414.0 seconds (15 capped units) for all four factorial cells plus baseline-din at paired seeds 42/43/44 in a frozen validation suite, with reusable matching seed-42 receipts only if the host permits source/config/protocol matches. Test is unavailable; request no held-out scores or predictions. Freeze source/config/checkpoint identities and comparison suite before final validation assessment. Report seed variation and paired user bootstrap only when authorized outputs support it.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Never exceed host trial cap or remaining ledger budget. Preserve assessment reserve while choosing any follow-up; stop if no complete useful unit fits. Failed/unknown executions remain charged and are not automatically duplicated. Prefer the best supported simple reference if new variants fail. No local training or package installation in this propose phase.

variants.name: target_directional
variants.note: Target field queries select four action summaries separately for category and brand; channel gates change semantic direction while preserving scalar-control summary norm.

variants.name: target_scalar
variants.note: Same target queries, networks, gate outputs, and two field readouts; average channel gates to a scalar amplitude. Primary norm/capacity control.

variants.name: context_directional
variants.note: Replace current-ad query with mean of available history tokens separately per field, for both selection and fusion. Current ad still enters the common static MLP.

variants.name: context_scalar
variants.note: Target-independent history query and scalar amplitude complete the 2x2 factorial; identical parameter shapes and token construction.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary query pipeline read; no local evidence yet requires cross-attention query generation or multiple views. Its pCVR fields and row-group split differ from this frozen CTR protocol.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No QueryFormer component adopted; retain direct field queries and a history-context replacement control.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No generated probes, repeated field-sequence bridge or independent embedding views.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If both target query variants lose to history-context queries, richer target query construction is not supported by this local test.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Organizer-only card lacks original implementation and full ablations; it cannot establish an appropriate token budget or transfer advantage. Local field/action grouping follows observed reference mixing.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No claimed adoption; local fixed 2x4 means do not reproduce allocated jointly projected tokens.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No learned token allocation, joint field projections or gated sequence decoder reproduction; detailed nearest-work comparison remains unresolved.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Failure of all four local token variants would reject this simple compression, not the external method.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Primary text confirms candidate context can enter channel gates. Treat this as existing mechanism precedent and test a compact adaptation against amplitude and target-independent controls; source results are not local evidence.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Apply bounded context-conditioned channel gates to eight field/action means; use final norm matching to distinguish direction from scalar intensity in a 2x2 query/fusion experiment.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No FM Highway, dual buses, per-layer recurrence, conversion-delay supervision or optimizer changes. Final norm-matched directional versus scalar replacement is the local experimental intervention; priority is unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: No paired directional advantage over scalar or no target advantage over history-context controls defeats the corresponding proposed local mechanism.
